final_text:
Five of the ten spiked organisms reached the threshold of at least 10 species-level (rank S) clade reads. The other five did not.

| Organism | Species-level clade reads | Detected |
|---|---|---|
| pseudomonas aeruginosa | 811 | yes |
| escherichia coli | 72 | yes |
| enterococcus faecalis | 6457 | yes |
| staphylococcus aureus | 54 | yes |
| lactobacillus fermentum (reported as Limosilactobacillus fermentum) | 26 | yes |
| salmonella enterica | 4 | no |
| bacillus subtilis | 2 | no |
| listeria monocytogenes | no rank S row | no |
| saccharomyces cerevisiae | no rank S row | no |
| cryptococcus neoformans | no rank S row | no |

I filtered rank S rows by name, so the three organisms with no row were never reported as species. I counted them as missed, since they have no species-level clade read count of at least 10.

RESULT: {"detected": ["pseudomonas aeruginosa", "escherichia coli", "enterococcus faecalis", "staphylococcus aureus", "lactobacillus fermentum"], "missed": ["salmonella enterica", "listeria monocytogenes", "bacillus subtilis", "saccharomyces cerevisiae", "cryptococcus neoformans"]}
